name: dubai-night-blonde-supermodel
image_vibe: Cinematic Dubai skyline, dramatic rim light, polished high-rise fashion editorial
image_purpose: Create a 3:4 luxury nightlife fashion visual with a recognizable urban skyline.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic cinematic fashion portrait on a high-rise balcony overlooking Dubai at night.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult blonde woman with piercing blue eyes and long silky blonde hair, wearing a black sheer polka-dot spaghetti-strap top layered over a sleek black body-hugging bodysuit, dark denim mini skirt, and an open brown oversized bomber jacket. She stands with arms wide in a confident fashion-editorial pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 portrait, high-rise balcony, epic Dubai nighttime cityscape with illuminated skyscrapers and Burj Khalifa dominating the skyline, dark sky, and clear silhouette separation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic cinematic lighting with strong rim light on hair and silhouette, soft facial key light, subtle fill, high contrast, vibrant city lights, and polished night atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5 aesthetic, 8K-style realism, portrait orientation, 3:4 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field, sharp natural skin and fabric texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic cinematic 3:4 fashion portrait of an original adult blonde woman with piercing blue eyes and long silky blonde hair, standing on a high-rise balcony with arms wide open over an epic Dubai nighttime cityscape. She wears a black sheer polka-dot spaghetti-strap top layered over a sleek black body-hugging bodysuit, dark denim mini skirt, and a brown oversized bomber jacket draped open. Include illuminated skyscrapers with the Burj Khalifa dominating the skyline, vibrant city lights and dark sky. Use strong cinematic rim light on her hair and silhouette, soft key light on her face, subtle fill, high contrast, Canon EOS R5-style 8K realism, shallow depth of field, and natural texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent underlayer, exposed underwear, nudity, unsafe balcony behavior, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed skyline

assets.name: source Dubai skyline reference
assets.usage: Use only for balcony composition, blonde fashion styling, Dubai skyline, lighting, and editorial mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the blonde hair, black polka-dot layered outfit, bomber jacket, balcony, Burj Khalifa skyline, 3:4 framing, and dramatic rim light. Keep the subject original adult and stage the balcony pose safely; skyline details may vary.
